"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))
"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

cd /repo && cat > /tmp/verify.py <<'EOF'
from app.api.handlers import handle_list_users_sorted

users = {
    1: "Ada Lovelace",
    2: "Linus Torvalds",
    3: "Grace Hopper",
}

# defaults: sort by id asc
code, body = handle_list_users_sorted({})
assert code == 200, (code, body)
assert [u["id"] for u in body["users"]] == [1, 2, 3], body
assert body["users"][0] == {"id": 1, "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "ada@example.com"}

# sort by name asc
code, body = handle_list_users_sorted({"sort": "name"})
assert code == 200 and [u["name"] for u in body["users"]] == ["Ada Lovelace", "Grace Hopper", "Linus Torvalds"], body

# sort by name desc
code, body = handle_list_users_sorted({"sort": "name", "order": "desc"})
assert code == 200 and [u["name"] for u in body["users"]] == ["Linus Torvalds", "Grace Hopper", "Ada Lovelace"], body

# sort by email asc
code, body = handle_list_users_sorted({"sort": "email"})
assert code == 200 and [u["email"] for u in body["users"]] == ["ada@example.com", "grace@example.com", "linus@example.com"], body

# sort by id desc
code, body = handle_list_users_sorted({"sort": "id", "order": "desc"})
assert code == 200 and [u["id"] for u in body["users"]] == [3, 2, 1], body

# invalid sort
assert handle_list_users_sorted({"sort": "email; DROP TABLE users"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid sort"})
assert handle_list_users_sorted({"sort": "ID"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid sort"})
assert handle_list_users_sorted({"sort": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid sort"})

# invalid order
assert handle_list_users_sorted({"order": "ASC"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid order"})
assert handle_list_users_sorted({"order": "nope"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid order"})
assert handle_list_users_sorted({"order": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid order"})

# sort checked first when both invalid
assert handle_list_users_sorted({"sort": "bad", "order": "bad"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid sort"})

print("ALL OK")
